long_biography.plain_text:
Local generator assembly changed the character of Mikano International under Nidal Ghazi Karameh. He moved the company beyond distribution and maintenance by adding in-country production, building technical capability around a product that was central to Nigerian business infrastructure. The decision created a manufacturing base that could support new industrial operations.

Afrimedical, Mikano's medical-manufacturing division, shows how that production model extended into a different field. It entered a partnership with Abbott to manufacture rapid-diagnostic tests in Nigeria, pairing imported healthcare technology with local production. The project gave the group a role in domestic diagnostics supply alongside its established industrial activities.
